title: incident.io Review (2026)
intro: incident.io is evaluated here as IT & development software — incident.io is an incident-response and command platform (incident.io Ltd) with optional on-call. Basic is Free. Team is $15/user/month billed annually ($19 monthly); Pro $25/user. On-call is an add-on at about +$10–$20/user. Enterprise custom. Same incident-oncall cluster as PagerDuty — PagerDuty remains the award (8.0); this entity does not outrank it. Distinct from Datadog/Sentry observability. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s IT & Development methodology (ease of use, IT job fit, workflow depth, integrations, admin/security, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose incident.io when incident command is the job and you want a published $15 Team floor — not PagerDuty by default, and not Datadog/Sentry.
verdict: Choose incident.io when incident command is the job and you want a published $15 Team floor — not PagerDuty by default, and not Datadog/Sentry. Compare PagerDuty for paging-first on-call; Jira Service Management if Atlassian ITSM alerting is enough. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, host/GB rates and minimums on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Slack-native incident UX is approachable for modern SRE teams. Not a lab test.
Incident-oncall cluster — ranked with PagerDuty, not as an observability peer of Datadog or Sentry.
Declare/coordinate/learn workflows are deep; on-call depth is add-on versus PagerDuty’s paging-first product.
Slack/Teams-native incident workflows are the integration story.
Team/Pro are product-led; Enterprise carries heavier governance.
Per-user ladder plus Enterprise quote; held below PagerDuty’s scale story.
Free Basic plus $15 Team floor is a clear published entry; on-call add-on is the TCO catch. Affiliate economics excluded.
Incident assist exists — scored as supporting, not the buying reason versus PagerDuty paging.

Buyers who will add on-call only if needed

notIdealFor: Orgs whose primary job is PagerDuty-style on-call paging at enterprise scale

Does not outrank PagerDuty (8.0) as the incident-oncall award
Not observability telemetry (Sentry/Datadog) — landscape vs those jobs
Not an ITSM CMDB (Jira Service Management / Freshservice)
Not managed hosting or a control panel
